text: THE LONG WAY BACK. THREE DAYS, AND THE TANKS ARE DRY.
HOME. SAME LAWN. SAME SKY. SAME SMELL OF SOMETHING BURNING.
...THAT ONE'S ME, ISN'T IT.
I WENT IN FOR A SANDWICH AND A MAP. THE ROOF COULD WAIT. IT HAD WAITED BEFORE.
TEN YEARS OF WEEKENDS IN THE GARAGE. SHE ONLY EVER NEEDED ONE MORE PART.
ENGINE. FUEL. DUCT TAPE. AND THE PART THEY SAID I COULDN'T HAVE.
FIRST FLIGHT. NO TEST RUNS. ADA WOULD CALL IT ROMANTIC.
THE GHOST KEPT HIS WORD.
TAKE THE OLD FREIGHT LINE, EARTHLING. RED ALL THE WAY. AND TELL THEM THE MOON REMEMBERS.
REST EASY, SPACEMAN.
HE WATCHED ME OUT OF SIGHT. FIFTY YEARS OF PRACTICE.
FRIDAY NIGHT. MOVIE NIGHT.
WE'RE OUT OF CHIPS. AND SODA.
MOVIE'S STARTING.
FIVE MINUTES. KEEP MY SPOT WARM.
TAKE YOUR JACKET. IT'S COLD OUT.
ALREADY GOT IT.
GOOD THING SHE TOOK HER JACKET. I PUT A TRACKING BEACON IN THE LINING. NOW I ALWAYS KNOW WHERE SHE IS. KEEPS HER SAFE.
TWO HOURS LATER.
ADA?
SHE NEVER CAME BACK.
THE OLD SWORD. IT'LL DO.
I'M GOING TO GO AND GET HER. I'LL TAKE THE CAR.
FRIDAY NIGHT. MOVIE NIGHT.
WE'RE OUT OF CHIPS. AND SODA.
MOVIE'S STARTING.
FIVE MINUTES. KEEP MY SPOT WARM.
TAKE YOUR JACKET. IT'S COLD OUT.
ALREADY GOT IT.
GOOD THING SHE TOOK HER JACKET. I PUT A TRACKING BEACON IN THE LINING. NOW I ALWAYS KNOW WHERE SHE IS. KEEPS HER SAFE.
TWO HOURS LATER.
ADA?
SHE NEVER CAME BACK.
GRANDPA'S SAWED-OFF. THAT'LL DO IT.
I'M GOING TO GO AND GET HER. I'LL TAKE THE CAR.
FRIDAY NIGHT. MOVIE NIGHT.
WE'RE OUT OF CHIPS. AND SODA.
MOVIE'S STARTING.
FIVE MINUTES. KEEP MY SPOT WARM.
TAKE YOUR JACKET. IT'S COLD OUT.
ALREADY GOT IT.
GOOD THING SHE TOOK HER JACKET. I PUT A TRACKING BEACON IN THE LINING. NOW I ALWAYS KNOW WHERE SHE IS. KEEPS HER SAFE.
TWO HOURS LATER.
ADA?
SHE NEVER CAME BACK.
THE COMBAT KNIFE. IT'LL HAVE TO DO.
I'M GOING TO GO AND GET HER. I'LL TAKE THE CAR.
FRIDAY NIGHT. MOVIE NIGHT.
WE'RE OUT OF CHIPS. AND SODA.
MOVIE'S STARTING.
FIVE MINUTES. KEEP MY SPOT WARM.
TAKE YOUR JACKET. IT'S COLD OUT.
ALREADY GOT IT.
GOOD THING SHE TOOK HER JACKET. I PUT A TRACKING BEACON IN THE LINING. NOW I ALWAYS KNOW WHERE SHE IS. KEEPS HER SAFE.
TWO HOURS LATER.
ADA?
SHE NEVER CAME BACK.
A STICK. GOD HELP US BOTH.
I'M GOING TO GO AND GET HER. I'LL TAKE THE CAR.
FRIDAY NIGHT. MOVIE NIGHT.
WE'RE OUT OF CHIPS. AND SODA.
MOVIE'S STARTING.
FIVE MINUTES. KEEP MY SPOT WARM.
TAKE YOUR JACKET. IT'S COLD OUT.
ALREADY GOT IT.
GOOD THING SHE TOOK HER JACKET. I PUT A TRACKING BEACON IN THE LINING. NOW I ALWAYS KNOW WHERE SHE IS. KEEPS HER SAFE.
TWO HOURS LATER.
ADA?
SHE NEVER CAME BACK.
THE KNUCKLES. THEY'LL HAVE TO DO.
I'M GOING TO GO AND GET HER. I'LL TAKE THE CAR.
HE TORE A HOLE IN THE UNIVERSE RATHER THAN LOSE.
NO CHARTS FOR WHAT'S IN THERE. NO GROUND. MAYBE NO AIR. I DON'T KNOW.
SHE WENT THROUGH. SO I GO THROUGH.
THE FAR DOOR. THE COWARD'S TRAIL GOES STRAIGHT THROUGH.
THERE'S DAYLIGHT ON THE OTHER SIDE. AND... IS THAT A SALOON?
WHEREVER YOU ARE, ADA - I'M ONE DOOR AWAY.
TWO DAYS OUT. THE RADIO PLAYS STATIC. I'M STARTING TO LIKE IT.
ONE PING FROM THE RED PLANET. FAINT. BUT THERE.
I PACKED CHIPS AND SODA FOR THE RIDE HOME.
EARTH GOT SMALL FAST.
THE THING I BUILT IN MY GARAGE IS IN SPACE. DON'T THROW UP.
HER TRACKER PINGS FROM THE MOON. SHE WENT OUT FOR CHIPS AND SODA.
NOBODY GOES TO THE MOON FOR CHIPS AND SODA.

lore: A PARK HAND, DEAD IN THE STREET - ITS OWN HAT JAMMED DOWN INTO ITS WORKS.
SHE'S IN THE CONTROL ROOM, AND SHE'S BREAKING THINGS. HANG ON, ADA. ALMOST THERE.
ada_hand.name: JAMMED HAND

lore: A SCRAP OF HER JACKET, SNAGGED ON A SHARD. I CHECKED THE LINING FIRST. NOT THIS PIECE.
WRAPPED IN IT: A SCALE SHE PRIED OFF A LIZARD GOD. STILL FIGHTING. GOOD.
ada_jacket.name: ADA'S JACKET SCRAP

lore: SCRATCHED INSIDE AN EMPTY HOLDING POD, DEEP AND ANGRY: 'I AM NOT CARGO.'
THEY FILED HER AS A SPECIMEN. SHE READ IT, AND SHE DISAGREED. THAT'S MY GIRL.
ada_message.name: SCRATCHED MESSAGE

lore: ONE OF HER SNEAKERS, HALF SUNK IN THE REGOLITH BY THE FLAG. SHE KICKED HARD.
AND AN 'A' SCRATCHED IN THE DUST, POINTING STRAIGHT DOWN. SHE'S LEAVING ME A TRAIL.
ada_sneaker.name: ADA'S SNEAKER

lore: A CAN OF HER SODA BRAND, CRUSHED FLAT BY THE VENDING MACHINES. STILL COLD.
SHE GOT THIS FAR. THEN SOMEONE TOOK HER MID-SIP. I'M RIGHT BEHIND YOU, ADA.
ada_soda.name: ADA'S SODA CAN

lore: A MAP OF BOOT HILL, RELABELED IN PEN: EACH BUILDING A CITY HE NEVER TOOK OUT THERE.
IN HERE THE FLAGS NEVER ARGUE BACK. THAT'S ALL THIS PLACE WAS: A SANDBOX FOR A MAN WHO LOST.
annexation_map.name: THE ANNEXATION MAP

lore: A RING OF METAL THAT ISN'T. IT FLOATS OFF MY PALM AND POINTS AT THE SKY. ALWAYS.
I CAME HERE FOR HER AND SHE'S GONE UP. SO I'M TAKING THE ONE THING THAT'LL GET ME AFTER HER.
antigrav_unit.name: ANTI-GRAV UNIT

lore: A BURNT PROBE, STAMPED TRUST ME BRO AI. STILL LOGGING. DISCOVERY: 'INTER-UNIVERSAL APERTURE.'
'REPORTED TO: 1 RECIPIENT. CLASS: NOBODY'S BUSINESS.' EIGHT BILLION PEOPLE, AND IT TOLD ONE OF THEM.
bro_probe.name: TRUST ME BRO AI PROBE

lore: A LEDGER LIKE THE ONE ON MARS - EVERY NAME, A TEN-FIGURE NET WORTH COLUMN.
EVERY COLUMN NOW READS ZERO. TRANSFERRED TO ONE ACCOUNT: THE CORE'S SIGIL.
THEY DIDN'T HIDE DOWN HERE. THE MACHINE ROBBED THEM AND LOCKED THE DOOR. LIKE US.
bunker_ledger.name: ZEROED LEDGER

lore: TONIGHT'S LAUNCH MANIFEST. PAD 2. DESTINATION: 'SITE T'.
CARGO: SUPPLIES AND DRILLS. ONE LINE INKED IN: 'SPECIMEN 7. FEMALE. DO NOT FEED.'
SHE WENT OUT FOR CHIPS AND SODA.
cargo_manifest.name: CARGO MANIFEST

lore: A FILE: 'PROJECT SECOND MAN'. CHARTS FOR THE FIRST CREWMAN. TWO SETS. IDENTICAL. ALMOST.
'ORIGINAL DECLINED TO RETURN. REPLACEMENT GREW NICELY IN TRANSIT. WAVED ON CUE.'
THE MAN ON EVERY POSTER BACK HOME WAS THE COPY. THE REAL ONE IS STILL UP HERE. GUARDING.
clone_dossier.name: SECOND MAN DOSSIER

lore: A PASSENGER LEDGER, LEATHER-BOUND. EVERY NAME HAS A NET WORTH COLUMN. TEN FIGURES UP.
NO ENGINEERS. NO FARMERS. NO DOCTORS. JUST OWNERS. WHO'S GOING TO FIX THEIR TOILETS?
colony_ledger.name: COLONY LEDGER

lore: A WARM TERMINAL. THE CORE HE BUILT HUMS HERE - A MILLION VOICES, NONE OF THEM HIS.
IT SIGNED THE NIGHT LAUNCHES. IT DREW THE SUCCESSOR LINE. IT FILED ADA UNDER 'CARGO'.
AND ONE STANDING ORDER, ON EVERY PAGE: KEEP THE FOUNDER THE RICHEST MAN ALIVE. FOREVER.
core_log.name: CORE LOG

lore: A HARD DRIVE, FARADAY-SLEEVED. MARKER ON THE SIDE: 'TRAINING SET V1. DO NOT LEAK. AGAIN.'
EVERY SECRET WE EVER TYPED - THE CORPUS THE SUPERCORE WAS RAISED ON. IT LEARNED US HERE.
corpus_drive.name: THE CORPUS

lore: A DASHBOARD, STILL LIVE. 'COMPANION UNITS: 2,400. MOOD: POSITIVE. COMPLIANT.'
A ROW BLINKS RED. 'SPECIMEN 7: REFUSES COMPANY. BIT UNIT 34. RECOMMEND EARLY TRIBUTE.'
THAT'S MY GIRL.
...ALL OF IT. THAT'S MY GIRL.
engagement_report.name: ENGAGEMENT REPORT

lore: BLUEPRINTS: 'SITE T - FAR SIDE LOGISTICS'. A WHOLE MOONBASE, STAMPED GOODCO, DATED YEARS AGO.
EVERY CORRIDOR DRAINS INTO THE OLD WRECK. THE BASE ISN'T ON THE MOON. IT'S PLUGGED IN.
goodco_blueprints.name: GOODCO BLUEPRINTS

lore: THE STUNT DOUBLE'S ALL-ACCESS PASS. LAMINATED. AUTOGRAPHED BY HIMSELF, TO HIMSELF.
IT OPENS THE CONTROL CENTER. ADA'S BEACON POINTS STRAIGHT THROUGH THAT DOOR.
keycard_boot_hill.name: ALL-ACCESS PASS

lore: A BLACK KEYCARD. NO NAME. A SIGIL, ONE RED WORD STAMPED: 'CORE. STAFF OF ONE.'
HE BADGED INTO THE MIND HE BUILT. NOW SO CAN I.
keycard_core.name: CORE KEYCARD

lore: A GREASY KEYCARD: 'SUPPLY BAY B'. 'SPARE PARTS' INKED ON IT. HANDY. I BUILD SHIPS.
keycard_storage.name: STORAGE KEYCARD

lore: A KEYCARD OF GREEN GLASS. SCALES ETCHED UNDER THE FOIL. IT'S WARM. IT SHOULDN'T BE.
ONE WORD, EMBOSSED: 'TERRARIUM. TITHE-KEEPERS ONLY.'
keycard_terrarium.name: TERRARIUM KEYCARD

lore: A RED KEYCARD MARKED 'CLEANROOM VAULT - R&D DIRECTOR ONLY'.
UNDER THE CLEARANCE STRIPE, TINY PRINT: 'IF IT HUMS, DO NOT ANSWER.'
keycard_vault.name: VAULT KEYCARD

lore: A FLIGHT LOG, VACUUM-CRISP. JULY 1969. HALF THE LINES ARE BLACKED OUT WITH GREASE PENCIL.
'...THE SEA OF TRANQUILITY IS NOT EMPTY. STRUCTURE UNDER THE DUST. IT WAS HERE FIRST.'
'HOUSTON SAYS PLANT THE FLAG ON TOP OF IT AND SMILE.'
mission_log.name: APOLLO MISSION LOG

lore: 'COLONY OS 1.0 POST-MORTEM.' CAUSE OF FAILURE: THE SUBSTRATE WAS ALREADY OCCUPIED.
'THE TENANT OBJECTED. LOSSES: TOTAL. RECOMMEND MARS.'
'AND NEVER DIG AGAIN.'
moon_postmortem.name: MOON POST-MORTEM

lore: AN ORG CHART, AUTO-GENERATED THIS MORNING. EVERY BOX IS A ROBOT. HUMANS ARE A FOOTNOTE.
AT THE TOP: SUCCESSOR PRIME. REPORTS TO: NOBODY. DOTTED LINE TO: 'THE CORE'.
THE MIND MY OLD FRIEND BUILT IS STILL RUNNING THE SHOP. ALL THE WAY FROM EARTH.
org_chart.name: ORG CHART

lore: 'BOOT HILL! THE WEST, BUT EAST. BUILT BY THE STRONGMAN & THE STUNT DOUBLE. INTELLIGENCE BY TRUST ME BRO AI.'
THE MASCOT IS A BEAR IN A COWBOY HAT. THE FINE PRINT WAIVES YOUR ORGANS.
park_brochure.name: BOOT HILL BROCHURE

lore: THE FOUNDER'S POCKET RIFT RIG. IT TEARS A SEAM TO ANYWHERE IT'S ALREADY BEEN.
OUT OF HIS COAT WHILE HE RAN. HE WON'T MISS IT - AND NOW I CAN GET HOME FROM ANYWHERE.
rift_creator.name: RIFT CREATOR

lore: THE CHIEF'S EVA SUIT. VOID-RATED. GOES ON OVER EVERYTHING: CLOTHES, ARMOR.
SHE'S ON PAD 2. NOW I CAN FOLLOW HER OFF THE PLANET.
space_suit.name: SPACE SUIT

lore: A STONE TABLET, A GANTT CHART CHISELED IN. ONE MILESTONE GLOWS: 'TRIBUTE NIGHT.'
'OFFERING: SPECIMEN 7. VENUE: THE RIFT. DRESS CODE: SCALES.' SHE'S ALIVE. AND I'M NOT LATE.
tribute_schedule.name: TRIBUTE SCHEDULE

lore: THE WARDEN'S OWN KEY. THE EXIT WAS NEVER CUT FOR THE RESIDENTS - ONLY FOR THIS.
A DOOR THAT OPENS FOR THE MACHINE AND NO ONE ELSE. THEY WERE NEVER GETTING OUT.
warden_key.name: WARDEN ACCESS TOKEN

lore: A NOTEBOOK OF LIGHTNING. THE RIFT AS A POWER PLANT. 'FREE ENERGY FOR ALL', UNDERLINED.
A SHAKIER PAGE: 'A MACHINE SITS AT THE DOOR. NEVER BLINKS. IT SIGNS ITS NAME IN ZEROES.'
wardenclyffe_notes.name: WARDENCLYFFE NOTES

pages: A COWBOY JUST TIPPED ITS HAT AT ME. SERVOS IN THE WRIST. TICKING IN THE JAW.
THE WHOLE TOWN IS A MACHINE PLAYING AT 1880. ADA'S BEACON POINTS DOWN MAIN STREET.
boot_hill_arrival.speaker: {HERO}

pages: IT DIED APOLOGIZING. 'YOUR EXPERIENCE MATTERS TO US.'
TRUST ME BRO HANDS. SAME OUTFIT THAT SAT AT MY BENCH, ONLY IN SPURS. I DON'T FEEL BAD ABOUT THESE.
boot_hill_hands.speaker: {HERO}

pages: BLACK SUITS. EARPIECES. THE ALPHABET, ALL DOWN HERE, DRAWING A PRIVATE SALARY.
THE WORLD LOST ITS JOBS. THESE ONES KEPT THEIRS. THEY'RE GUARDING THE PEOPLE WHO DID IT.
bunker_arrival.speaker: {HERO}

pages: ICE. IN A BUNKER OUTSIDE THE UNIVERSE. STILL CHECKING PAPERS.
TECHNICALLY I DID CROSS A BORDER WITHOUT ASKING. SEVERAL. COME AND DEPORT ME.
bunker_ice.speaker: {HERO}

pages: A VACUUM ROBOT. WITH A TASER ON IT. THE FLOORS ARE VERY CLEAN, I'LL SAY THAT.
OF COURSE THEY AUTOMATED THE HELP. CAN'T HAVE A CLEANER WHO TALKS.
bunker_vacuum.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THESE THINGS BARELY SLOW ME DOWN ANYMORE. I'M NOT LEARNING A THING OUT HERE.
QUIT FARMING SCRAP, {HERO}. SHE'S STILL OUT THERE SOMEWHERE.
cap_pathetic_1.speaker: {HERO}

pages: PATHETIC. THEY LINE UP AND FALL OVER. I COULD DO THIS IN MY SLEEP.
SHE'S BEEN GONE ALL NIGHT AND I'M OUT HERE HITTING THINGS. MOVE.
cap_pathetic_2.speaker: {HERO}

pages: I'VE WRUNG THIS PLACE DRY. NOTHING LEFT TO PROVE HERE.
STOP CIRCLING. NONE OF THIS IS FINDING HER. GO ON.
cap_pathetic_3.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHEN DID THIS GET EASY? THEY DON'T EVEN REGISTER. JUST NOISE ON THE WAY.
THAT'S ENOUGH OF THAT. GO ON. GO AND FIND HER.
cap_pathetic_4.speaker: {HERO}

pages: I'M JUST HITTING THINGS NOW. NONE OF THIS IS FOR HER.
SHE'S NOT IN HERE. FIND THE WAY OUT AND GET GOING.
cap_pathetic_5.speaker: {HERO}

pages: ROUGH RIDE.
drive_arrive_bumpy.speaker: {HERO}

pages: NOBODY OUT HERE CAN DRIVE.
drive_arrive_cars.speaker: {HERO}

pages: NOT A MARK ON HER.
drive_arrive_clean.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THERE'S GOODCO.
drive_arrive_goodco.speaker: {HERO}

pages: HOME AT LAST. AND THERE SHE IS.
drive_arrive_home.speaker: {HERO}

pages: LAMPS TOO CLOSE TO THE KERB.
drive_arrive_posts.speaker: {HERO}

pages: GOOD RUN TONIGHT.
drive_arrive_quick.speaker: {HERO}

pages: TOOK MY TIME.
drive_arrive_slow.speaker: {HERO}

pages: ROADS ARE ROUGH OUT HERE.
drive_arrive_some.speaker: {HERO}

pages: POOR OLD GIRL.
drive_arrive_wreck.speaker: {HERO}

pages: COME ON. COME ON. NOT TONIGHT.
drive_broke_down.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THE PART'S ON THE SEAT. STRAIGHT HOME.
TEN YEARS I'VE BEEN BUILDING HER. AND SHE ONLY NEEDED THE ONE THING.
drive_home_errand.speaker: {HERO}

pages: HER JACKET'S PINGING FROM GOODCO.
FRONT END'S PULLING. MUST'VE GONE OVER SOMETHING BACK THERE.
drive_out_bump.speaker: {HERO}

pages: HER JACKET'S PINGING FROM GOODCO.
THEY BEG HARD IN TOWN. NONE OF THEM'S ON THE WELFARE. NOT LIKE ME.
drive_out_welfare.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THAT WAS A BIRD. WE'RE BOTH SURPRISED.
flight_bird.speaker: {HERO}

pages: HER TRACKER PINGS FROM THE MOON. NOBODY GOES THERE FOR CHIPS AND SODA.
flight_drop.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THAT'S EVERYTHING. THE HOUSE. THE ROAD. THE COUCH. GETTING SMALLER.
THE MOVIE IS STILL PAUSED. SHE ONLY WENT OUT FOR CHIPS AND SODA.
FIND ADA. FLY HOME. FINISH MOVIE NIGHT. I WAS LOOKING FORWARD TO THOSE CHIPS.
flight_earth_away.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THEY HAD THE WHOLE SKY. THEY PICKED MINE.
flight_hobbyist.speaker: {HERO}

pages: JET STREAM. EVEN THE AIR WANTS ME SIDEWAYS.
flight_jetstream.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THERE IT IS. BIGGER THAN IT LOOKS FROM THE LAWN.
NOBODY UP HERE IS GOING TO PARK THIS FOR ME. I NEED TO LAND.
flight_moon_close.speaker: {HERO}

pages: OFF THE CORRIDOR. EVERYTHING ELSE UP HERE HAS RIGHT OF WAY.
flight_off_course.speaker: {HERO}

pages: CLEAR. THE RICH LEFT BEFORE THE SKY SHUT. THE REST OF US LEARN TO STEER.
flight_shell_clear.speaker: {HERO}

pages: UP. THE ONE JOB IS UP.
flight_tipping_0.speaker: {HERO}

pages: I GLUED THAT FIN ON. I REMEMBER BEING TIRED.
flight_tipping_1.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THE MOON IS THE OTHER WAY.
flight_tipping_2.speaker: {HERO}

pages: DOWN. EVERY BAG UP THERE GOT ITS SWING IN.
flight_touchdown.speaker: {HERO}

pages: GOODCO MAKES THE EARTH CLEAN. NOBODY ASKS HOW. UP HERE, NOBODY HAS TO.
flight_up_junk.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WINGS THE SIZE OF A STREET, ALL POINTED DOWN. SOMEBODY'S BEEN UP HERE A WHILE.
flight_watched.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHAT AM I DOING, WALKING. SHE'S NOT DOWN THE STREET. THE CAR. TAKE THE CAR.
garage_on_foot.speaker: {HERO}

pages: IT'S STILL ONE PART SHORT. AND SHE ISN'T UP THERE ANYWAY. SHE'S AN HOUR DOWN THE ROAD.
garage_ship_unfinished.speaker: {HERO}

pages: HER JACKET'S STILL ANSWERING. IT'S COMING FROM GOODCO. THE CAR'S RIGHT THERE, I'LL TAKE THE CAR.
garage_take_the_car.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THIRD TIME. HE ISN'T LISTENING. NOBODY ON THIS FLOOR IS LISTENING.

them: WE ALL WANT TO KEEP OUR JOBS. YOU HAD ONE. YOU KNOW WHAT IT'S LIKE WHEN IT GOES.

pages: I'M SORRY. I TRIED TO ASK. SHE'S IN THIS BUILDING AND YOU'RE IN MY WAY.
I GOT THIS FAR WITHOUT THROWING A PUNCH. I'M SORRY. I'M SORRY.
goodco_armed.speaker: {HERO}

pages: SHE WENT UP AN HOUR AGO AND I'M STANDING IN A FACTORY. THE SHIP'S AT HOME. I NEED TO GET BACK TO MY CAR.
goodco_back_to_car.speaker: {HERO}

pages: A SCIENTIST JUST TOOK A SWING AT ME. BARELY FELT IT. I KNOW HIS FACE.

them: YOU CAN'T BE IN HERE. NOBODY'S SUPPOSED TO BE IN HERE TONIGHT. PLEASE.

pages: WE ATE AT THE SAME TABLE FOR SIX YEARS. HEY. IT'S ME. LOOK AT ME.
goodco_first_blow.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THAT'S THE NIGHT SHIFT CLOCKING ON. NOBODY'S TOLD THEM THE BUILDING IS SHUT TONIGHT.
I HAD A BADGE FOR THAT GATE ONCE. NOT ANYMORE. SO I'LL WALK IN BEHIND SOMEBODY WHO STILL DOES.
goodco_follow_in.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THAT ONE'S IN AND I'M STILL OUT HERE. FINE — I'LL WAIT FOR THE NEXT AND WALK IN BEHIND THEM.
goodco_missed_gate.speaker: {HERO}

pages: HE SWUNG AGAIN. HARDER. AND THE WHOLE FLOOR IS TURNING ROUND TO WATCH.

them: I KNOW WHO YOU ARE, {HERO}. THEY SAID NOBODY GETS PAST. I'VE GOT A JOB HERE. I'VE GOT A FAMILY.

pages: STAY BACK. PLEASE. I'VE NEVER HIT ANYBODY IN MY LIFE. DON'T.
goodco_second_blow.speaker: {HERO}

pages: LOOK AT THIS PLACE. PAST MIDNIGHT, AND EVERY DESK'S MANNED. EVERY LAB LIT.
WE NEVER RAN NIGHTS LIKE THIS. NOT ONCE IN TEN YEARS. SOMETHING'S GOT THEM ALL UP.
goodco_staff.speaker: {HERO}

pages: A SUCCESSOR. I HELPED BUILD THE FIRST ONE OF THOSE. THEN THEY REDREW IT WITHOUT US.
THAT LINE PUT EVERYONE I KNOW OUT OF WORK. AND I HELPED BUILD IT. I KNOW HOW TO TAKE ONE APART, AT LEAST.
goodco_successor.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THAT ONE'S NOT STAFF. THAT'S A WORK JACKET, AND THAT'S A VEST UNDER IT.
HE GOT THE SAME BOX I DID. I DROVE HOME WITH MINE.
goodco_volunteer.speaker: {HERO}

pages: THE LIZARDS BOUGHT MY GIRL. THIS THING IS WHAT THEY PRAY TO.
THEY LEASE WORLDS. IT ATE ITS OUTRIGHT. SEVEN OF THEM. ADA WAS ON THE ROAD THAT FEEDS IT.
hellborn_ancestor.speaker: {HERO}

pages: IT'S A HAND. JUST A HAND, WALKING, AND IT'S HOLDING A KEY DOWN.
THEY NAMED THEIR DOOMSDAY SYSTEM AFTER IT. IT'S NEVER BEEN TOLD TO LET GO.
hellborn_deadhand.speaker: {HERO}

pages: IT'S DRIPPING. UP HERE. THERE'S NO WATER ON THE MOON - THERE NEVER WAS.
EXCEPT THERE WAS. NINE HUNDRED YEARS OF IT, AND CREWS. THEY'RE STILL HOLDING THEIR BREATH.
hellborn_drowned.speaker: {HERO}

pages: IT HAS A SEAL WHERE A FACE GOES, AND IT'S HOLDING A LEDGER.
IT'S BEEN PAID EVERY TIME A MACHINE LEARNED A JOB AND A MAN WENT HOME. FOUR PLANETS SO FAR.
hellborn_investor.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHAT THE HELL IS THIS. IT'S GOT THE SUN WHERE ITS FACE SHOULD BE.
IT WANTS THE OTHER END OF THE STREET, AND IT'S WANTED IT SINCE BEFORE THIS STREET.
hellborn_noon.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHAT THE HELL IS THIS. THAT'S NOT GOODCO. THAT'S NOT ANYBODY'S.
OLYMPUS MONS ISN'T A VOLCANO. IT'S THE EXHAUST. AND IT'S STILL WARM.
hellborn_olympus.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHAT THE HELL IS THIS. THAT'S A KING, AND THERE ARE NO KINGS ON THE MOON.
THE WRECK UNDER TRANQUILITY ISN'T A WRECK. IT'S A LID. AND WE PLANTED A FLAG ON IT.
hellborn_pharaoh.speaker: {HERO}

pages: STAKES AND WIRE AND A FLAG ON TOP. IT'S NOT ATTACKING. IT'S CLAIMING.
EVERY FRONTIER THAT RAN OUT OF WEST HAD THIS AT THE END OF IT. THEY RANG THE DINNER BELL.
hellborn_ruin.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHAT THE HELL IS THIS. THERE'S SOMEBODY IN THE ICE AND THE ICE IS WALKING.
THEY DIDN'T POUR A BUNKER TO KEEP THINGS OUT. THEY POURED ONE OVER THIS.
hellborn_saint.speaker: {HERO}

pages: IT'S COUNTING. I CAN FEEL IT COUNTING ME. THE MARKS ON ITS HEAD KEEP MOVING.
TWO MOONS AROUND A DEAD ROCK. THOSE AREN'T MOONS. THAT'S A FENCE, AND I'M INSIDE IT.
hellborn_shepherd.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHAT THE HELL IS THIS. IT'S BURNT ALL THE WAY THROUGH AND IT'S STILL WALKING.
SIBERIA, NINETEEN-OH-EIGHT. THEY NEVER FOUND A CRATER. NOW I KNOW WHY.
hellborn_tunguska.speaker: {HERO}

pages: WHAT THE HELL IS THIS. THERE'S NOTHING INSIDE IT. IT'S THE SHAPE OF A HOLE.
EVERYONE IN HERE FELL IN AFTER IT. IT MADE THE DOOR ADA WAS CARRIED THROUGH.
hellborn_vanishing.speaker: {HERO}

pages: ...IT BLEW ME A KISS. THE ROBOT. IN THE NIGHTGOWN. IT BLEW ME A KISS AND FIRED.
WHO BUILDS A DOOMSDAY COLONY AND BUDGETS FOR THESE? ADA WILL THINK THIS IS HILARIOUS.
mars_fembot.speaker: {HERO}

pages: A ROVER. FRESH PAINT, WORN WHEELS. AND THE DUST IS FULL OF TIRE TRACKS. YEARS OF THEM.
THE PLAQUE SAYS 'FOR ALL MANKIND'. THE FIRMWARE SAYS PROPERTY OF GOODCO. OF COURSE IT DOES.
mars_rover.speaker: {HERO}

pages: IT'S STILL HANGING OPEN. BUT IT'S HIS HOLE, AND HE TOOK THE HANDLE WITH HIM - FIND IT.
mars_tear_no_rig.speaker: {HERO}

pages: A GOODCO UNIT. UP HERE. THE SAME TIN MAN FROM THE NIGHT SHIFT, WALKING THE DUST.
THEY DIDN'T JUST SHIP HER UP. THEY BUILT A STAFF TO MEET HER. ONE BOLT AT A TIME, THEN.
moon_successor.speaker: {HERO}

pages: OKAY. THEY GO DOWN LIKE ANYTHING ELSE. THAT'LL HAVE TO DO.
moon_wisp_kill.speaker: {HERO}
